'''Calypso''' was a form of [[Music/Legends|music]] commonly played by [[entertainer]]s during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Sometime prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Diskret Stahn]] traveled much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]]. During this time, one particular tune got stuck in his head, much to his chagrin. Sometime later, his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] came under attack by pirates while he was transporting dancer [[Pei Yi]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. His ship's engine was damaged in the attack, though he was able to land on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] for repairs and supplies. Unfortunately for him and Pei Yi, they ended up stranded in the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] for a quite a long time.

While stranded in the facility, Stahn encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was skilled in [[Entertainer|entertaining]]. He told the entertainer the story about the tune stuck in his head, as well as the drama that led him to land on Mustafar. After conversing with the entertainer, Stahn decided to teach the entertainer his tune, which was turned into a song called calypso. Following the event, calypso [[Music/Legends|music]] was frequently played by [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] and other entertainers in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and other locations across the galaxy. It could also be played by a wide variety of musical instruments.

==Behind the scenes==
Calypso music was first added to the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] with its third and final expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']]. In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], players of the [[W:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]] could learn the [[W:c:swg:Entertainer Songs|song]] from a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] named [[Diskret Stahn]].

The song bore a very strong resemblance to the theme song used in the [[1990]] [[LucasArts]] game, [[Wikipedia:The Secret of Monkey Island|''The Secret of Monkey Island'']]. In the real-world, [[Wikipedia:Calypso music|calypso]] is a style of [[Wikipedia:Afro-Caribbean music|Afro-Caribbean music]].
